Muhlenkamp & Co Inc decreased its stake in Apple Computer Inc. (AAPL) by 37.72% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Muhlenkamp & Co Inc sold 54,998 shares as the company’s stock rose 5.37% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 90,824 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $15.24 million, down from 145,822 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Muhlenkamp & Co Inc who had been investing in Apple Computer Inc. for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $920.02 billion market cap company. The stock increased 1.12% or $2.07 during the last trading session, reaching $187.18. About 15.35M shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 22.56% since July 3, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 9.99% the S&P500.
Analysts await Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) to report earnings on August, 7. They expect $2.19 earnings per share, up 31.14 % or $0.52 from last year’s $1.67 per share. AAPL’s profit will be $10.76 billion for 21.37 P/E if the $2.19 EPS becomes a reality. After $2.73 actual earnings per share reported by Apple Inc. for the previous quarter, Wall Street now forecasts -19.78 % negative EPS growth.
